transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the catalog for publication, I'd like to do our routine pre-publication check-in on 'Glass Harbor.' I see the current draft lists it at 94 minutes with premiere status still marked for confirmation. Could the submissions team and technical screening staff please report any status or master-file issues you're aware of for this film? I need to make a final programming decision on whether it goes into the national competition or the panorama program.
